# PyPI

1 endpoint, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 1 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/pypi/project - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one release of a PyPI project, the latest by default: the project name (`post.id` and `post.ext.title`), its PyPI page, the one-line summary (`post.content.text`) and the long description (`post.ext.description`, often Markdown). `post.ext.pypi` adds the version, the Python versions it supports, its dependencies as declared (`requires_dist`, with their version ranges and extras), the project's links, the licence, whether the release was yanked, and every file of the release with its download link, size, sha256 digest, package type, Python tag and upload time. A project or version PyPI does not have answers 404 and is not charged.

**Use when** you want to check a Python dependency, see what a release requires, or verify the files you download.
**Cost** cache 600 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `project` (optional, string) - The project name as published on PyPI, for example requests or scikit-learn. Send project or url. · e.g. `requests`
- `url` (optional, string) - The project's PyPI page, for example https://pypi.org/project/requests/ (a version in the link picks that release). Send project or url.
- `version` (optional, string) - A published release such as 2.31.0. Leave it out for the latest release.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `project`, `url`.

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.ext.title` | The post title on its own. |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+6 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `post.ext` {description, pypi}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Never filled: `post.author.avatar_url`, `post.author.display_name`, `post.author.username`, `post.author.verified`, `post.content.duration_seconds`, `post.content.media_urls`, `post.content.thumbnail_url`, `post.engagement.comments`, `post.engagement.likes`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.shares`, `post.engagement.views` (+1 more).

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/pypi/project" \
  --data-urlencode "project=requests" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
